# Lipi — Indic Voice Editor

> Speak or type across 12 Indic languages in real time with Web Speech API and in-browser Paar neural translation.

## What this app does
Lipi is a browser-based Indic voice and text editor supporting 12 Indian languages: Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Telugu, Tamil, Gujarati, Urdu, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia, and Assamese. Users can dictate natively in any of the 12 Indic locales via the Web Speech API, or speak/type in English and translate locally in the browser using Udgam Labs' quantized Paar ONNX models running on Transformers.js.

## Links
- [Lipi App](https://h3manth.com/ai/lipi/): The live web application
- [Paar Models](https://udgamlabs.com/models/paar): Udgam Labs English-to-Indic neural translation models
- [Transformers.js](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers.js): In-browser ONNX inference runtime
- [Source Code](https://github.com/hemanth/lipi): GitHub repository
- [Author](https://h3manth.com): Hemanth HM

## Features
- 12 Indic languages: Hindi (`लिपि`), Bengali (`লিপি`), Marathi (`लिपी`), Telugu (`లిపి`), Tamil (`லிபி`), Gujarati (`લિપિ`), Urdu (`لپی`, RTL Nastaliq), Kannada (`ಲಿಪಿ`), Malayalam (`ലിപി`), Punjabi (`ਲਿਪੀ`), Odia (`ଲିପି`), and Assamese (`লিপি`)
- Real-time native Indic speech streaming via Web Speech API
- Live English-to-Indic voice and text translation powered by Udgam Labs Paar models in-browser
- Phonetic English-to-Kannada typing helper (`ಕ` toggle)
- Full BiDi text editor with voice punctuation commands, auto-save to `localStorage`, clipboard copy, and `.txt` export

## Tech stack
- Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS (zero frontend framework)
- Web Speech API (`SpeechRecognition`) for real-time streaming dictation
- Hugging Face Transformers.js (`@huggingface/transformers@3`) running quantized `q8` Paar ONNX models in a dedicated Web Worker
